view.space.fore.prompt: Pure deep space, full frame: a soft blue and violet nebula, faint distant stars, a lot of calm dark space in the middle. No cockpit, no window frame, no console, no ships, no planets. Nothing else.

view.space.aft.prompt: Pure deep space, full frame: a receding blue and violet nebula, faint distant stars, calm dark space in the middle, and only a soft warm amber light glow rising from the very bottom edge as if from engines out of view. briefing.admiral.prompt: Admiral Lorenzen, a grey-haired stern but kind fleet admiral in a dark blue uniform with gold braid, seated at his large desk at Starbase 27 command, a window onto space and docked ships behind him. At the top of the picture a printed letterhead band reading exactly "STAR BASE 27 COMMAND" in bold retro chrome letters, no other text.

ui.invoice.prompt: A flat scan of a sheet of 1980s continuous-feed computer printer paper, seen exactly straight on and filling the entire picture edge to edge (no desk, no background, no shadow around it): pale cream paper with faint pale-green horizontal bar stripes, a column of round tractor-feed holes along the left and right edges with perforation lines. At the top a printed letterhead in dark blue ink with a small round Psi emblem and the words exactly "PSI 5 TRADING COMPANY"; everything below the letterhead is blank paper (no other text, no numbers). Slight warm airbrushed paper texture.

logo.prompt: The title logo of a 1986 space trading game: the words exactly "PSI 5 TRADING COMPANY" on one line, in heavy bevelled chrome airbrushed letters with a magenta and cyan edge glow, a single star-burst lens flare on one letter. Exactly that text, correctly spelled, nothing else.
